search_text: published ZDI-13-253 ZDI-CAN-1834 ABB RobotStudio Tools CWGraph3D ActiveX Control Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-11-24 7.5 ['ABB'] ['RobotStudio'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ABB RobotStudio Tools. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the cw3dgrph.ocx ActiveX control. The ImportStyle method allows an attacker to load a specially crafted .cwx file from a remote network share. Following this call, the attacker can invoke the ExportStyle method to save the file to an arbitrary location through the use of a directory traversal vulnerability. A remote attacker can abuse this to execute arbitrary code under the context of the user. ABB has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://www05.abb.com/global/scot/scot348.nsf/veritydisplay/8e134e13bfa25a0cc1257c0600459b16/$file/SI10253A2%20rev%200%20.pdf ['2013-04-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2013-11-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi aka rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-13-253/
title: ABB RobotStudio Tools CWGraph3D ActiveX Control Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ABB RobotStudio Tools. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the cw3dgrph.ocx ActiveX control. The ImportStyle method allows an attacker to load a specially crafted .cwx file from a remote network share. Following this call, the attacker can invoke the ExportStyle method to save the file to an arbitrary location through the use of a directory traversal vulnerability. A remote attacker can abuse this to execute arbitrary code under the context of the user.
